hookups.source: recreation.gov public campsite catalog for facility 233489 (23 RV ELECTRIC sites list 50-amp, 44 list 30-amp) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233489 ('86 family campsites, 71 of which have electrical hookups'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 86 family sites (71 electric, 16 tent-only) plus one large electric group site. RV sites take 45 ft on recreation.gov; 10 are pull-throughs. One non-electric RV site.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233489 ('Downstream Campground offers 86 family campsites, 71 of which have electrical hookups; 16 sites are tent-only. One large group campsite is available with electrical hookups.') + public campsite catalog (RV sites max length 45 ft, 10 Pull-through driveways), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Playgrounds, basketball court, horseshoe pits, amphitheater, fishing pier; firewood and ice sold.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233489 ('The campground offers flush and vault toilets, showers, playgrounds, cornhole boards, a basketball court and horseshoe pits. A dump station is available on-site.'; amenities 'Accessible Drinking Water', 'Firewood Vender', 'Ice', 'Amphitheater', 'Fishing Pier'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reservable on recreation.gov up to arrival day; a reservation not arrived by checkout time after the first night is cancelled entirely. 14 nights in a rolling 30 days.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233489 (notice 'Reservations that have not arrived will be no-showed at checkout time of their first night of stay. This will cancel your entire reservation.'; rules maxStay 14 nights Rolling 30 Days, reservationCutOff 0), read 2026-10-22

note: USACE Fort Peck Project campground in a cottonwood grove just below Fort Peck Dam on the Missouri River; fishing ponds. Typically open May-Sep. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov: confirmed 86 family sites (71 electric, 16 tent) with 50-amp on 23, 45-ft sites with 10 pull-throughs, flush/vault toilets, showers, dump, reservable. Added potable water, recreation.gov platform, 14-night limit; fees ($15 non-electric RV / $25 electric) left as checked. Season not stated (rate seasons only; USACE page blocked). recreation.gov carries a 'militaryDiscount' rule flag but no stated discount, so discounts left. Note trimmed of restated values.
